title: ASI, developer of AI tool SMART, says the FAA outage "is not based on or a result of the SMART system, any product of ASI, or our integration with FAA and ATC" (Asi/@airspaceintel)
summary: Asi / @airspaceintel: ASI, developer of AI tool SMART, says the FAA outage “is not based on or a result of the SMART system, any product of ASI, or our integration with FAA and ATC” — The current ground stop is not based on or a result of the SMART system, any product of ASI or our integration with FAA and ATC.
